ns2:section.sectionText: The course explores how cultural, sociological and psychological factors shape consumer behavior. This course will provide an overview of the key concepts of the discipline of consumer behavior and will enable students to put into practice their newfound understanding of consumer behavior to shape branding strategies. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of the department. To request enrollment, please complete the “Non-Degree Enrollment Request Form” here: https://sbc.illinois.edu/non-degree-request-information/https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/9478165.
